sources.excerpt:
The Fish Factory by Menatone | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Menatone The Fish Factory LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS BOOSTER OVERDRIVE EQUALIZER Description The Menatone Fish Factory is the ultimate compact tone machine. It consists of the 4 knob Red Snapper and the Blue Collar overdrives. Each pedal is independant and can be used alone or together to create a myiad of tonal options. All of this in a small box with input, output and dc jacks located on top. The new vertical version takes up even less precious real estate on your board. This new version also includes an effect order switch. Now you can decide if the Red Snapper is first in the chain or the Blue Collar. 9v power supply only... no battery Media Videos Demo by GuitarSiam Thailand (OTHER) Manuals Manual (EN) Reviews Review by guitar pedal X (EN) Review by The Gear Page (EN) Links Product Page Technical data Width 000.00 mm Depth 000.00 mm Height 000.00 mm Circuit type analog Voltage 9V DC, center negative Current 20mA More pedals from Menatone TREMOLO TREMOLO Menatone Pleasure Trem Mini OVERDRIVE BOOSTER OVERDRIVE BOOSTER Menatone Blue Collar BOOSTER OVERDRIVE BOOSTER OVERDRIVE Menatone Blue Collar Mini Menatone Dumbstruck All Menatone Pedals Products Pedalboards All-In-One Patchbays QuickMount PedalSafe Power Supplies and Power Cables and Connections Accessories Gear Build your own board Board Configurator PedalPedia Pedalboard Gallery QuickMount Finder Services Find a dealer Find a distributor Frequently Asked Questions Contact Current catalog News Community RockBoard Artists Achievements Your Activity Overview ©2026 Warwick GmbH & Co.
